mascot.name: Pip
mascot.design: Our own small baby elephant (a nod to PHP's elePHPant, not the official mascot; built in src/lib/mascot): egg-shaped body, two big round ear flaps with salmon inners, a short curled trunk with 2-3 wrinkle ticks, a 3-strand head tuft, 3 downward-bowed back wrinkles (the cat's stripes), cream toenails, salmon soles, dot eyes, no tusks, no text, no logo. Loose 3.4 px ink with open contours (top of head between the ears and the base left open), flat fill offset 3 px right / 2 px down. Size: scale 1.0 (~96 px sitting) in wide shots, never below 0.75; in camera moves he is kept at constant screen size (screen space) so he never shrinks to a speck. Plays the reference cat's role: perched, watching, reacting, one small physical gag per scene timed to its word, never covering the thing being explained, the sun or the counter. Exactly ONE look to camera in the film (S04 'right?'). Crosses every transition (hop, fall, ride). Poses used: sit-back, sit-front, stand-side, walk-side, trunk-up, hold (+Flashlight / new-lock props), ears-cover, sleep; one requested extra: trunk-cross (S13, fallback hold + expression closed). Supporting cast (not mascots): Bit, a solid-ink beetle (the bug: 16 px in wide shots, ~60 px in close-up) hiding in plain sight from frame 0 to the final frame; a sand-shelled snail (running gag S09-S11).
mascot.colorway: periwinkle #8D90CC body (shade per src/lib/mascot/colors.ts), salmon (= theme peach) ear inners, cheeks and soles, cream toenails, ink #2B1B0A. Periwinkle is reserved for Pip: no scene object ever uses it (PHP markers are sand plates with an ink elephant).

scenes.setting: STORY PEAK 1/3 (true Arcane-scale hook). Government Plaza in Webtown, a city where every building is a website. Four monumental government buildings (four countries) stand shoulder to shoulder at the far edge of a vast empty plaza; the huge low sun sits in the gap behind the capitol dome; an endless city fades to the horizon behind them. The viewer stands low on the plaza behind three back-view onlookers.

Four frontal government buildings, bases on the plaza's far edge y 1200, tops 480-640 (never above y 470, so the caption sky stays clean). Tiny citizens 40-55 px at y 1215-1300. Foreground framing: lamp post cropped at left, tree crown cropped at right, three big back-view onlookers on the bottom edge. Pip on a bollard right-middle. Quiet field = sky (~45%). Orange = sun only.

beats.action: Frame 0 = loop seam state (see transitionIn). Camera push starts. Sun begins its rise from (628,740) to (628,700), ease-out 0.37 s, then +7% pulse 0.30-0.55.
'Government': fill cascade radiates out from the sun gap, 1-frame pops, 2-3 regions per frame: far city, govB, govC, govA, govD, plaza, citizens, onlookers; complete by 0.40.

'websites': browser chrome reveals in all four main windows: three dots pop with overshoot (0.04 s stagger) and the address-bar pill draws on (0.2 s); order govB, govA, govC, govD, 0.08 s apart. This is the 'building = website' teach.
Screens switch on: window glow fills pop cream with a peach page-header block and 3 ink hairlines inside each window (0.90-1.05).
'in': nine tiny citizens rise in on the plaza (rise 0.33 s out(exp), 0.05 s stagger, left to right).
'four': four pennants unfurl one per beat at 1.23 / 1.38 / 1.53 / 1.68 (scaleX 0->1, 6% overshoot), a counting tick each. Sun pulse +6% on 'four' (1.325).
Three pigeons land on the lamp crossbar (0.06 s stagger).
Two citizens raise phones (arm lines + white phones). Pip's ear flicks; he looks toward govB (look 0.3).
'just': a bold cream power glyph inks onto the sun (ring arc then bar, 0.17 s), replacing the faint one.
'switched': the sun is PRESSED like a power button (squash to 0.88 over 0.08 s, release 0.2 s) and one ink ripple ring expands from it (r150->190, 0.2 s). This press is the deliberate act.
Shutter 1 slams down over govA's browser window (0.16 s, 6 px bounce); govA's fills step one palette step darker as it lands.
'themselves': shutter 2 slams on govB, govB goes dark.
'-selves': shutter 3 slams on govC, govC goes dark (its clock face stays white).

'off': shutter 4 slams on govD, govD goes dark; the lantern on the lamp post switches off (cream -> sand); the pigeons scatter off the crossbar (3.30); Pip startles: quick trunk-up hop on the bollard (3.28-3.60, expression wide).
Plant: 'back soon' clock tags swing onto each shutter (3.40-3.55, 0.05 s stagger, pendulum -16..0 deg, 0.5 s).
'Nobody': padlocks pop onto the four shutters at 3.64 / 3.72 / 3.80 / 3.88, each with a small click.
'hacked': Pip looks left, then right (look -0.6 -> 0.6), checking. No intruders anywhere; every door and wall is intact.
'them': all four padlocks glint at once (pairs of ink glint diagonals pop).
Push-through begins: camera accelerates into govB's door lock. Pip launches a hop toward frame centre-bottom (he lands in S02).

beats.action: 'For': the noticeboard rises from the pavement in front of siteM (rise 0.33 s); camera push-in begins.
Pip hops from the bollard onto the board top (lands 67.05), sit-back like the reference cat.
'those': five audience heads rise on the bottom edge (0.1 s stagger).
'it's': the board's address-bar rail lights (cream pill + dots).
'switch': pane 1: a big power glyph draws on (0.17 s); the sun echoes a small press (squash 0.94 on 67.55).
'off': pane 1 pops dark (tealDark), its glyph turns cream: lights out.
'or': pane 2's peach answer panel scales in from 0.2 (0.30 s, completes 68.68).
'hope': Pip crosses his trunk (trunk-cross; fallback: hold pose, expression closed); the sun's stepped glow discs pop behind it.
'hosting': the caretaker rises into pane 2 (rise 0.30 s).
His big key ring pops up and jingles (keys swing). The hosting visual is on screen 0.77 s before the un-build.
'company': the keys glint; we never see whether he sorts it out (honest open ending).
'sorts': UN-BUILD begins: lines go loose (ink overshoots extend, 3 frames).
Fills shrink to their centres (69.90-70.08, ease-in); audience sinks out.
Board linework retracts (70.00-70.13).
The remaining colour collapses into one tan slab that slides down out of frame (70.05-70.25, ease-in), revealing the S01 plaza line art and mint sky at camera rest.
Pane 1's power glyph floats up and docks on the sun as the faint frame-0 glyph (70.10-70.47); the sun glides to (628,770).
Pip hops from the vanishing board to his S01 bollard (70.15-70.52), in colour the whole time.
S01 linework draws in row by row (70.20-70.55); Bit hops back onto govA's cornice (70.30).
Caption rolls: the last page exits up, 'Government websites' rolls in (hook scale).
The sun begins its opening rise (628,770 -> 748 by 70.687 -> 740 at frame 0): the seam is mid-motion.

scenes.sun: Glides to peek over siteM's roof during the push; small press echo on 'switch' (67.55); stepped glow on 'hope' (68.80). In the un-build it receives pane 1's power glyph as the faint frame-0 glyph, sinks to (628,770) and starts the opening rise at 70.60.
scenes.mascot: Hops onto the board top (the reference cat's finale spot). Gag: crosses his trunk on 'hope' (68.80). Rides the un-build back to his frame-0 bollard, never losing colour.

loop: S13's un-build (69.84-70.687) ends on the exact frame-0 state: the S01 plaza linework at camera rest (ink on unfilled white shapes, people as white tombstones), the mint sky block, the sun at (628,~748) already rising and carrying pane 1's power glyph as the faint frame-0 glyph, Pip in full colour sit-back on his bollard (760,1440), Bit back on govA's cornice, and the caption 'Government websites' rolled in (70.48-70.687, settled by frame 0).
